description: Ozon Intelligence SR: ozon/product Report Search API.

brand.description: Brand filter: `{brandName: array<string>, type: integer}`; `type` is `0` included, `1` excluded, `2` unbranded.

categoryIds.description: SR Array of category IDs, not category names.

keywords.description: Array of keywords filtered by product title.

labels.description: Tag array: `0` New, `1` Authentic, `2` Best Seller.

memberId.description: Member ID; the data is attributed to this member.

orders.description: Sorting rule, the element is `{field, direction}`; `direction` takes `DESC` or `ASC`, `field` can be `sales`, `revenue`, `price`, `reviewRating`, `reviewCount`, `salesRate` and other response indicator fields.

searchDate.description: Query date, the format is `yyyy-MM-dd`; for example, `2026-04-01` is used to query data in March 2026.

skus.description: SKU array, up to 10, used to accurately query specified products.

variationsMerge.description: Whether to merge variants: `0` is not merged, `1` is merged.
